newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor down on speculative offerings.
newsitem.headline: India castor down on speculative offerings.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery dropped to 1,147/1,148 rupees per quintal from 1,152/1,153 rupees on fresh speculative offerings on Thursday, dealers said.
"Sluggish export demand dragged prices lower in limited activity," they said.
"Foreign buyers are demanding Indian castoroil at 705/710 dollars per tonne while Indian offers are at 735/740 dollars," one operator said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 378/380 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes but demand resistance at the higher level kept prices quiet after recent gains.

In Rajkot spot groundnut oil fell by 5 rupees at 595/600 rupees per 15 kg. In Bombay imported palm-oil was steady at the reduced level of 255/256 rupees per 10 kg on stray outstation support. Marketmen reported arrivals of about 5,000 tonnes of imported palm-oil at Mumbai port recently and they were expecting more supplies next week.
"Any price rise for palm-oil from the current level may prove short-lived," one importer said.
